summary: Build practical skills in workload balance, boundary setting, and burnout prevention. Enrol in this 5-day course today.
lede: Work-life balance training covers practical ways to assess workload pressure and support sustainable work patterns. It is designed for HR, wellbeing and people managers who need to address pressure points while meeting operational demands, with practice in workload mapping, task prioritisation using the Eisenhower Matrix, and setting clear communication boundaries. Participants also learn to guide workload conversations, track absence trends and pulse survey feedback, and turn findings into practical team actions.
audienceIntro: This work-life balance training is designed for professionals who influence workload, wellbeing, and sustainable performance across teams and departments.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in a professional environment and a basic understanding of team workflows, workload planning, and people management practices. No coding is required. A willingness to reflect on current work patterns, review team routines, and complete practical exercises using templates and case scenarios will support the best learning outcome. Experience in HR, line management, employee support, or workplace wellbeing is helpful but not mandatory.
